_about: Controlled pattern ids for prompt-language-coach. Every counted error gets exactly one id so repeats aggregate. 'category' is the usual category; preposition and verb-pattern errors can be either. Add a new id only when none fits, and give it a label and example.

article.label: Missing or wrong article or determiner
article.example: use SOSP template -> use the SOSP template

verb-form.label: Wrong verb form after a modal, auxiliary, or passive
verb-form.example: can be shorten -> can be shortened

tense.label: Tense or aspect
tense.example: I send it yesterday -> I sent it yesterday

agreement.label: Subject-verb agreement
agreement.example: the figure show -> the figure shows

question-order.label: Question word order or missing auxiliary in a question
question-order.example: What would be the risk you think? -> What do you think the risk would be?

omitted-word.label: Missing subject, object, or verb
omitted-word.example: Would be any challenges? -> Would there be any challenges?

sentence-boundary.label: Run-on sentence, comma splice, or fragment
sentence-boundary.example: is using docs change the path -> is using docs; change the path

negation-coordination.label: not/nor/neither/or coordination
negation-coordination.example: not a policy nor mechanism -> not a policy or a mechanism

degree-modifier.label: very/much/too with adjectives
degree-modifier.example: not much hard -> not very hard

preposition.label: Wrong or missing preposition
preposition.example: in the bottom -> at the bottom

verb-pattern.label: Verb complement pattern
verb-pattern.example: asking about X to my friend -> asking my friend about X

word-choice.label: Word with the wrong meaning
word-choice.example: a comb with date -> combine the date

unnatural-construction.label: Understandable but unnatural construction
unnatural-construction.example: memory can be reclaimable -> memory could be reclaimed
